# Symbolab

> Symbolab is a comprehensive online math solver and calculator platform offering step-by-step solutions across calculus, algebra, geometry, and specialized domains.

Symbolab provides interactive calculators and solvers for mathematical problems ranging from basic arithmetic to advanced calculus, with graphing tools and domain-specific calculators for physics, finance, and fitness. The platform emphasizes educational value through detailed step-by-step solutions.

## Key Topics

- Step-by-step solutions
- Calculus solver
- Algebra calculator
- Graphing calculator
- Matrix calculator
- Derivative calculator
- Integral calculator
- Geometry calculator
- Interactive graphs
- Equation solver
- Function visualization
- Educational tool
- Online calculator
- Math solver
- Interactive calculator

## Core Math Solvers

- [Step-by-Step Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver): Main step-by-step calculator for algebra, calculus, geometry, and statistics
- [Algebra Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/algebra-calculator): Algebra solver for equations with step-by-step solutions
- [Derivative Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/derivative-calculator): Derivative calculator for symbolic differentiation with steps
- [Integral Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/integral-calculator): Integral calculator with step-by-step solutions and graphing
- [Matrix Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/matrix-calculator): Matrix calculator for linear algebra operations step-by-step

## Graphing Tools

- [Graphing Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/graphing-calculator): Interactive graphing calculator for functions and inequalities
- [Line Graph Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/graphing-calculator/line): Interactive line graph calculator for linear equations
- [Quadratic Graph Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/graphing-calculator/quadratic-graph): Quadratic graph calculator with intercepts and extreme points
- [Exponential Graph Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/graphing-calculator/exponential-graph): Exponential function graphing with asymptote analysis
- [Sin Graph Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/graphing-calculator/sine-graph): Sine graph calculator for trigonometric function visualization

## Geometry Calculators

- [Geometry Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/geometry-calculator): Interactive geometry calculator for shapes and proofs
- [Pythagorean Theorem Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/geometry-calculator/pythagorean-theorem-calculator): Pythagorean theorem calculator for triangle solving
- [Circle Area Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/geometry-calculator/circle-area-diameter-calculator): Circle area calculator for geometry problems

## Specialized Calculators

- [Calculators Directory](https://www.symbolab.com/calculators): Directory of all Symbolab calculators and math tools
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/calculator/math/percentage): Percentage calculator for conversion and calculation
- [Compound Interest Rate Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/calculator/finance/compound_interest_rate): Compound interest calculator for investment planning
- [Acceleration Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/calculator/physics/acceleration): Acceleration calculator for physics kinematics problems
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/calculator/fitness/bmi): Body Mass Index calculator for health assessment
